en.headline: Electronics fairs open Tuesday with more than 120 robots on show
en.dek: The Hong Kong Electronics Fair and electronicAsia will bring over 3,200 exhibitors to Wan Chai, highlighting AI applications and interactive robot demonstrations.
body: The Hong Kong Electronics Fair (Autumn Edition) and the concurrent electronicAsia will open on Tuesday at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai, running until Friday.

Organised by the Hong Kong Trade Development Council, the events are expected to gather more than 3,200 exhibitors from 15 countries and regions. A RoboPark zone will feature more than 120 robots demonstrating uses in commercial services, industrial operations, entertainment and healthcare, including humanoid models and interactive stations where robots serve coffee and popcorn.

The fairs will also include themed zones on AI, smart wellness and entertainment technology, with free registration available for industry visitors. Organisers said the showcases aim to help companies explore commercial applications of artificial intelligence and robotics.

zh.headline: 秋電展及電子組件展周二開幕 展出逾120款機械人
zh.dek: 香港秋季電子產品展及國際電子組件展將於灣仔會展舉行，匯聚逾3200家展商，重點展示人工智能應用及互動機械人示範。
body: 第46屆香港秋季電子產品展及同期的第29屆國際電子組件及生產技術展將於星期二在灣仔香港會議展覽中心開幕，展期至星期五。
由香港貿易發展局籌辦，兩展預計吸引來自15個國家及地區逾3200家展商。RoboPark專區將展出逾120款機械人，涵蓋商業服務、工業營運、娛樂及醫療保健等應用，包括人形機械人及由機械人沖咖啡、製作爆谷的互動站。
展覽亦設人工智能、智能健康及娛樂科技等主題區，業界訪客可免費登記入場。主辦方表示，展示旨在協助企業探索人工智能及機械人的商業應用。
